GroupCanvas.RootHint.en: Edit the current group in the complete root project while keeping the current layer level

GroupCanvas.RootNotice.en: Edit the current group within the full root project. Selection and edits stay within the current level.

GroupCanvas.ReadOnly.en: This offline snapshot is read-only. Its content cannot be changed.
